name: mimo-proxy
description: A small, native TypeScript bridge for Xiaomi MiMo

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/server.ts dist/mimo-server && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/cli.ts dist/mimo-chat && npm run build:launcher
scripts.build:server: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/server.ts dist/mimo-server
scripts.build:cli: node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs src/cli.ts dist/mimo-chat
